sentences.text: Me llamo Nico y tengo diez años.
sentences.english: My name is Nico and I am ten years old.

sentences.text: Hoy es domingo, y voy al culto con mi abuela.
sentences.english: Today is Sunday, and I am going to the service with my grandmother.

sentences.text: Doña Marta es vieja, pero es amable y simpática.
sentences.english: Doña Marta is old, but she is kind and nice.

sentences.text: La iglesia es blanca y azul, y es muy bonita.
sentences.english: The church is white and blue, and it is very pretty.

sentences.text: El pastor es alto y delgado.
sentences.english: The pastor is tall and thin.

sentences.text: La Biblia del pastor es negra.
sentences.english: The pastor's Bible is black.

sentences.text: Mi bolsa es verde, y la bolsa de mi abuela es roja.
sentences.english: My bag is green, and my grandmother's bag is red.

sentences.text: Primero la gente canta un himno.
sentences.english: First the people sing a hymn.

sentences.text: Es una canción difícil, pero mi abuela canta muy bien.
sentences.english: It is a difficult song, but my grandmother sings very well.

sentences.text: No entiendo todas las palabras.
sentences.english: I do not understand all the words.

sentences.text: El idioma de los himnos es diferente.
sentences.english: The language of the hymns is different.

sentences.text: Yo hago una pregunta.
sentences.english: I ask a question.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Abuela, ¿qué quiere decir alabanza?
sentences.english: Grandmother, what does praise song mean?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Una alabanza es una canción para Dios.
sentences.english: A praise song is a song for God.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Alabamos a Dios con ella.
sentences.english: We praise God with it.

sentences.text: Después viene otra alabanza.
sentences.english: Then comes another praise song.

sentences.text: Todos cantamos y adoramos a Dios.
sentences.english: We all sing and worship God.

sentences.text: Dice la gente: "La gloria es de Dios."
sentences.english: The people say: "The glory is God's."

sentences.text: Luego el pastor habla de la oveja perdida.
sentences.english: Then the pastor talks about the lost sheep.

sentences.speaker: P
sentences.text: Dios busca a la gente perdida.
sentences.english: God looks for lost people.

sentences.speaker: P
sentences.text: Dios perdona y salva.
sentences.english: God forgives and saves.

sentences.speaker: P
sentences.text: Dios es el rey del mundo.
sentences.english: God is the king of the world.

sentences.speaker: P
sentences.text: Dios bendice a los niños y a las niñas.
sentences.english: God blesses the boys and the girls.

sentences.speaker: P
sentences.text: Dios hace milagros, y los ángeles alaban a Dios.
sentences.english: God does miracles, and the angels praise God.

sentences.text: Después viene la ofrenda.
sentences.english: Then comes the offering.

sentences.text: Mi abuela pone dinero en la bolsa.
sentences.english: My grandmother puts money in the bag.

sentences.text: Yo también pongo un poco de dinero.
sentences.english: I also put in a little money.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Abuela, ¿para qué es la ofrenda?
sentences.english: Grandmother, what is the offering for?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Para cuidar la iglesia y para ayudar a la gente.
sentences.english: To take care of the church and to help people.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: La ofrenda ayuda también a la salud de la gente, en la clínica.
sentences.english: The offering also helps people's health, at the clinic.

sentences.text: Hoy el pastor tiene la garganta mal.
sentences.english: Today the pastor has a bad throat.

sentences.text: Tiene una cita con el doctor mañana.
sentences.english: He has an appointment with the doctor tomorrow.

sentences.text: Yo tengo la nariz roja y tos, pero estoy contento.
sentences.english: I have a red nose and a cough, but I am happy.

sentences.text: Hay una mujer joven con su esposo.
sentences.english: There is a young woman with her husband.

sentences.text: Se casaron hace un año.
sentences.english: They got married a year ago.

sentences.text: Tienen una niña pequeña.
sentences.english: They have a little girl.

sentences.text: La niña nació hace un mes.
sentences.english: The girl was born a month ago.

sentences.text: El pastor bendice a la niña.
sentences.english: The pastor blesses the girl.

sentences.text: También hay un hombre viejo.
sentences.english: There is also an old man.

sentences.text: Su esposa murió, y él está triste.
sentences.english: His wife died, and he is sad.

sentences.text: Mi abuela habla con él.
sentences.english: My grandmother talks with him.

sentences.text: Ella tiene dos nietos, y yo soy uno.
sentences.english: She has two grandchildren, and I am one.

sentences.text: Yo quiero crecer y ser alto como el pastor.
sentences.english: I want to grow up and be tall like the pastor.

sentences.text: Los jóvenes terminan con la última canción.
sentences.english: The young people finish with the last song.

sentences.text: Al fin del culto hay comida: pollo, arroz, frijoles y verdura.
sentences.english: At the end of the service there is food: chicken, rice, beans and vegetables.

sentences.text: Yo no quiero la verdura.
sentences.english: I do not want the vegetables.

sentences.text: Es fea.
sentences.english: They are ugly.

sentences.text: Mi abuela dice: "Comé la verdura.
sentences.english: My grandmother says: "Eat the vegetables.

sentences.text: Es buena para la salud."
sentences.english: They are good for your health."

sentences.text: Es fácil estar con mi abuela en la iglesia.
sentences.english: It is easy to be with my grandmother at church.

sentences.text: Después de comer, Kevin y yo jugamos en el parque.
sentences.english: After eating, Kevin and I play in the park.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: Nico, ¿qué edad tenés?
sentences.english: Nico, how old are you?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Tengo diez años.
sentences.english: I am ten.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: ¿Y vos?
sentences.english: And you?

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: Tengo ocho.
sentences.english: I am eight.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: Soy más pequeño que vos.
sentences.english: I am smaller than you.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: ¿Te gustó la iglesia hoy?
sentences.english: Did you like church today?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Sí.
sentences.english: Yes.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Me gustó la oveja perdida.
sentences.english: I liked the lost sheep.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: El pastor habló bien.
sentences.english: The pastor spoke well.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: Yo no entiendo todo.
sentences.english: I do not understand everything.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: Tengo muchas preguntas.
sentences.english: I have many questions.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Yo también.
sentences.english: Me too.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Mi abuela dice que las preguntas son buenas.
sentences.english: My grandmother says that questions are good.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: ¿Qué es un milagro?
sentences.english: What is a miracle?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Mi abuela dice: un milagro es cuando Dios ayuda a la gente.
sentences.english: My grandmother says: a miracle is when God helps people.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: ¿Y un ángel?
sentences.english: And an angel?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Un ángel es de Dios.
sentences.english: An angel is from God.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Mi abuela dice que Ana es como un ángel.
sentences.english: My grandmother says that Ana is like an angel.

sentences.text: Regreso a la casa con mi abuela.
sentences.english: I go back home with my grandmother.

sentences.text: Sam llega también.
sentences.english: Sam arrives too.

sentences.text: Mi abuela mira mi plato.
sentences.english: My grandmother looks at my plate.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Tu plato está limpio, Nico.
sentences.english: Your plate is clean, Nico.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: ¡Comiste la verdura!
sentences.english: You ate the vegetables!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Sí, abuela.
sentences.english: Yes, grandmother.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Estoy feliz.
sentences.english: I am happy.

sentences.text: Sam y mi abuela leen la Biblia en la mesa.
sentences.english: Sam and my grandmother read the Bible at the table.

sentences.text: Yo miro a mi abuela y a Sam.
sentences.english: I look at my grandmother and Sam.

sentences.text: Los dos son mi familia.
sentences.english: The two of them are my family.

sentences.text: El culto es bonito, y el último himno es muy bueno.
sentences.english: The service is nice, and the last hymn is very good.

sentences.text: Gracias, Dios, por mi domingo.
sentences.english: Thank you, God, for my Sunday.
